parameter_origin: previous h6 development, which already included July; frozen for both arms
training_rule: expanding origin; target_available_at strictly before first validation origin
forecast_schedule: one forecast per validation origin; model weights fixed within each fold
metric_aggregation: pooled validation rows; mean_absolute_fold_bias is a separate fold statistic

source_selection.policy: valid_time == origin + horizon; available_at <= origin; latest eligible run_time

source_weather.weighting: installed_capacity; fixed registry for this sample
source_weather.coverage_policy: all plants and capacity weight sum 1; otherwise NaN features
source_weather.spatial_std: weighted population standard deviation across locations
source_weather.wind_speed_cubed_mean_m3s3: weighted mean of local speed cubed; not electrical power
